scope: Actual production useMenuGamepad hook, React callbacks and browser-native dialog focus/cancel. navigator.getGamepads is a declared synthetic input provider; native RAF, focus, requestClose, cancel and DOM results are not mocked. No gameplay, saves, Next integration or physical-controller qualification.

checks.name: Two actual native modal dialogs open in reverse DOM order
Direction and confirm target only the focused native top layer
Back requests cancellation of Alpha, restores Beta focus and held input never cascades
Next distinct Back closes Beta through its real React cancel owner
Only a subsequent root Back invokes the existing menu callback
Native cancellation veto is respected without falling through to root Back
Removing the veto lets the native owner close and keeps the root untouched
Inert owner blocks confirm/Back and held Back cannot leak on resume
Inert root blocks confirm/Back and held Back cannot leak on resume
Legacy role/aria-modal controls and their original Back callback remain compatible
Native keyboard Escape still follows React cancellation and preserves root
Hook, navigation input contract, fixture and recipe remain byte-identical during run
